dialogues.speaker: Staelle
dialogues.text: *sigh* The vagaries of writing serial novels...

dialogues.speaker: Staelle
dialogues.text: I originally took this up as relief from boredom. I never expected the romance novel I wrote to be so popular.

dialogues.speaker: Staelle
dialogues.text: I was quite naive at the time, signing that serialization contract as I did. And now, I find myself struggling late into the nights over my writing progress...

dialogues.speaker: Staelle
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm stopping once I finish this series. I mean, it's not as if I need the Mora...
